title: 第4章 神秘老头（下）
slug: 九阳剑圣全本免费-九阳剑圣最新章节列表
content_zh:
阳顶天跟着读了一遍，然后写了一遍。接着在雪地上写了汉字你，读了出来，又指了指老头，表示这是你的意思。
老头很快掌握，而且读得非常准确，写得依旧比阳顶天好。
接下来是眼睛，鼻子，嘴巴，头发，皮肤，肉，血管，筋脉，肚子，脚，大雪，冰，台阶，天空等词语。
阳顶天本来就十分聪明，老头更加聪明绝顶。
整整十几个小时，一直到雪停了，两个人一直在学习对方的语言和文字。
老头教了阳顶天整整189个字，五十几个词语。学习完毕后，老头竟然用汉语来考核阳顶天。
比如，老头指着天上的乌云，说出了乌云两个字，让阳顶天说出这个世界的乌云怎么读，怎么写？
阳顶天说对的话，老头报以一笑，阳顶天说错的话，老头就直接一个耳光打过来。
那个耳光真的很疼，不过老头好像更疼，因为他的断骨还没有完全长好，有一次他打阳顶天耳光，甚至自己都吐了血。于是阳顶天再也不敢出错了，出了错之后，赶紧狠狠自己扇自己的耳光，也不敢让老头来打了，而且他自己打得比老头还要重，直接把自己打肿，有些时候血都打出来。
尽管阳顶天非常聪明，但是十几个小时，几百个字，近百个词语，还是会错一些。所以，最后整张脸被自己打得如同猪头一样红肿，牙齿都有些松了，吐出来的口水都是血。
老头始终没有一点怜惜，一旦错了，就目光如刺地盯着阳顶天。
直到最后学习结束的时候，老头伸手抚摸了一下阳顶天红肿的面孔，让阳顶天内心升起一道温暖。
“你去做冰台阶！”老头竟然是用汉语说出来的话，然后缓缓闭上了眼睛，再次进入坐闭状态。
“您，您不要吃东西吗？”阳顶天问道，老头没有理会，尽管这个时候他几乎已经能够听到阳顶天这句话的意思了。
阳顶天讪讪一笑，然后仔细为老头整理好衣衫，用手梳理好他的头发，最后才去做寒冰台阶。
就这样，一天一天地过去。
大部分时候，老头都在闭目坐关，每隔十天就丢给阳顶天一颗火红的药丸，维持阳顶天的生命和能量。
只有开始下雪的时候，他才会睁开双目，在雪地上写字教阳顶天这个世界的语言和文字，同时也学习地球的汉语。
当雪停了之后，两个人停止学习，老头再次闭目进入坐关，阳顶天继续去做寒冰台阶。
时间一天一天地过去。

环绕洞壁而上的寒冰台阶越来越高，阳顶天掌握这个世界的语言和文字也越来越多。而老头，几乎已经完全掌握了主要汉语文字，因为他完全是聪明绝顶的，一旦掌握了汉语文字的规律和精髓后，就完全会融会贯通自我学习了，所以到后面他甚至能够指出阳顶天一些汉语的偏僻错误，所以老头的智慧完全让阳顶天惊绝不已。
不过阳顶天对这个世界语言文字的学习一开始很顺利，到后来就慢慢变得艰难了。一开始十个小时阳顶天能学习一百多个字，但是后来越来越慢。因为这个世界完全是武力的世界，完全是玄气的世界，对于很多名词阳顶天根本就没有概念，实在太过于抽向了。
为了让阳顶天准确地掌握，老头甚至要完全将那些名次和概念完全翻译成为汉语，然后再教给阳顶天。
所以本来已经不怎么挨打的阳顶天再一次挨打了，每一次学习，都被自己抽得面孔红肿如同猪头一样。
老头依旧无比的严厉，目光依旧无比的犀利。
但是当阳顶天转身的时候，老头望着他的目光顿时充满了柔软了怜惜。
时光渐渐地流逝……
一个月，两个月，三个月……
半年时间过去了，冬天过去了，下雪的天气越来越少了。但是，寒冰台阶只完成了一大半！
天气越来越热（当然，只是相对而言）
阳顶天对这个世界的语言文字差不多已经完全掌握了，平常也可以用这个世界的语言文字进行交流了，对这个世界也有了足够的了解。
这个世界叫混沌大陆！土地面积比地球要大很多，人口也比地球多，这完全是一个武力为尊的世界，玄气是这个武力世界的基础，每个人都有不同的玄脉，天赋高的修为便高，天赋低的修为便低。
可以说，这个世界完全是武者的世界，万般皆下品，唯有武道高。想要成为人上人只有一条道路，那就是习武。

content_en:
Yang Dingtian read it and then wrote it again. Then he wrote the Chinese character you on the snow, read it out, and pointed at the old man to express that this was what you meant.
The old man mastered it quickly, and his reading was very accurate, and his writing was still better than Yang Dingtian.
Next are words such as eyes, nose, mouth, hair, skin, flesh, blood vessels, tendons, belly, feet, snow, ice, steps, sky, etc.
Yang Dingtian was already very smart, and the old man was even smarter.
For more than ten hours, until the snow stopped, the two people kept learning each other's language and writing.
The old man taught Yang Dingtian a total of 189 characters, more than fifty words. After finishing the study, the old man actually used Chinese to assess Yang Dingtian.
For example, the old man pointed at the dark clouds in the sky and said the word "dark clouds", asking Yang Dingtian to tell him how to read and write the word "dark clouds" in this world.
If Yang Dingtian said something right, the old man would smile in return. If Yang Dingtian said something wrong, the old man would slap him in the face.
That slap really hurt, but it seemed to hurt the old man even more because his broken bone hadn't fully grown back yet. One time he slapped Yang Dingtian and even vomited blood. So Yang Dingtian didn't dare to make a mistake anymore. After he made a mistake, he quickly slapped himself hard and didn't dare to let the old man hit him. Moreover, he slapped himself even harder than the old man, directly swollen himself and sometimes even bled.
Although Yang Dingtian is very smart, after more than ten hours, hundreds of words, and nearly a hundred words, he still makes some mistakes. Therefore, in the end, his entire face was as red and swollen as a pig's head, his teeth were a little loose, and his spit was filled with blood.
The old man never showed any pity. Once he made a mistake, he would stare at Yang Dingtian with piercing eyes.
At the end of the study, the old man reached out and touched Yang Dingtian's red and swollen face, which made Yang Dingtian feel warm in his heart.
"You make the ice steps!" The old man actually said it in Chinese, then slowly closed his eyes and entered the sitting state again.
"You, don't you want to eat?" Yang Dingtian asked. The old man ignored him, although at this time he could almost hear the meaning of Yang Dingtian's words.
Yang Dingtian smiled, then carefully arranged the old man's clothes, combed his hair with his hands, and finally made the ice steps.
Just like that, day by day passed.
Most of the time, the old man sat with his eyes closed, throwing a fiery red pill to Yang Dingtian every ten days to maintain Yang Dingtian's life and energy.
Only when it starts to snow, he will open his eyes and write on the snow to teach Yang Dingtian the language and writing of this world, while also learning the Chinese language of the earth.
When the snow stopped, the two of them stopped studying. The old man closed his eyes again and entered the meditation, while Yang Dingtian continued to do the ice steps.
Time passes day by day.
The ice steps surrounding the cave wall are getting higher and higher, and Yang Dingtian has mastered more and more languages ​​and characters in this world. The old man has almost completely mastered the main Chinese characters, because he is completely smart. Once he has mastered the rules and essence of Chinese characters, he will be able to fully integrate and self-study, so later he can even point out some of Yang Dingtian's remote mistakes in Chinese, so the old man's wisdom completely surprised Yang Dingtian.
However, Yang Dingtian's learning of this world's languages ​​went smoothly at first, but later it gradually became difficult. Yang Dingtian could learn more than a hundred characters in the first ten hours, but then it became slower and slower. Because this world is completely a world of force, a world of profound energy, Yang Dingtian has no concept of many terms, it is too abstract.
In order for Yang Dingtian to grasp them accurately, the old man even had to completely translate those rankings and concepts into Chinese and then teach them to Yang Dingtian.
So Yang Dingtian, who had rarely been beaten in the past, once againI was beaten, and every time I studied, my face was as red and swollen as a pig's head.
The old man was still extremely stern and his eyes were still extremely sharp.
But when Yang Dingtian turned around, the old man's eyes were suddenly full of softness and pity when he looked at him.
Time passes gradually...
One month, two months, three months...
Half a year has passed, winter has passed, and the snowy weather has become less and less. However, the ice steps are only half completed!
The weather is getting hotter (of course, only in relative terms)
Yang Dingtian has almost completely mastered the language and characters of this world. He can usually communicate in the language and characters of this world, and he has enough understanding of this world.
This world is called Chaos Continent! The land area is much larger than that of the earth, and the population is also larger than that of the earth. This is a world where force is respected. Xuanqi is the foundation of this world of force. Everyone has different profound veins. Those with high talent will have high cultivation, and those with low talent will have low cultivation.
It can be said that this world is completely a world of warriors, everything is inferior, only martial arts is high. There is only one way to become a master, and that is to practice martial arts.
